source: inconsistent. Studies of knowledge conflict have observed both over-reliance on external evidence and persistence of incorrect internal knowledge under different conditions. The engineering implication is to encode source policy explicitly and test it. If the application requires the provided corpus to be authoritative, say so, include provenance, and evaluate counterfactual cases where the model’s memorized answer differs. If the corpus itself can be wrong, blind context obedience is also unsafe. For high-stakes conflicts, return the disagreement or seek another source rather than forcing the model to pick one. ZXNAME0000XZ changes the evidence available to the model; it does not automatically calibrate how the model arbitrates evidence. [18][19]
zh: 不一致。对知识冲突的研究发现，在不同条件下，过度依赖外部证据和错误内部知识的持续存在。工程含义是显式编码源策略并对其进行测试。如果应用程序要求提供的语料库具有权威性，请明确说明，包括出处，并评估模型记忆的答案不同的反事实情况。如果语料库本身可能是错误的，那么盲目的上下文服从也是不安全的。对于高风险的冲突，返回分歧或寻求另一个来源，而不是强迫模型选择一个。 ZXNAME0000XZ 更改模型可用的证据；它不会自动校准模型如何仲裁证据。 [18][19]
